Heavy broad boxlike lower faces, black open mouths, bold outer/fine inner lines, hatching and dotted gray recur. Face shape and internal arrangement differ from the existing tall hollow-cheeked mature angular family. Requested compact eye/nose/mouth placement is weak and noses are large; overlapping hands remain somewhat hard to read.

prompt.en: A candid unlettered working moment in a small flower shop. A twenty-eight-year-old woman with short wavy hair wears a plain long-sleeved shirt and full trousers. She stands beside a window at one counter, holding a plain vase steady with one hand while arranging a long leafy stem with the other. Her adult face, connected shoulders and arms, vase, stem, counter and shop shelves share one coherent space. Bold monochrome comic caricature with broad angular cheeks and a heavy square jaw. Each clothed adult has one strongly blocklike head joined through its neck to connected shoulders and arms. Very small white eyes with tiny black pupils sit under thick blunt black brows. A large blunt nose projects with firm nostril accents; a wide expressive mouth opens into a strong black shape. Thick firm outside contours and finer short crease strokes emphasize the exaggerated face. Slanted hatching, dotted gray and hard local black masses build the cheek and chin volume while leaving bright white planes.

observation.ja: 着衣の人物1人が花瓶の枝葉に手を添え、店内の鏡に人物が映る場面。鏡像を別の人物見本とは数えていません。幅広い箱形下顔、黒口、強い外線と細い内線、斜線の灰を男女画と共有。横顔の顎先はやや細く、鏡像との顔形の差が残ります。目鼻口の強い圧縮も十分ではありません。浮遊頭部や明白な増肢は見当たりません。
observation.en: One clothed person touches branches in a vase while reflected in a shop mirror; the reflection is not counted as a separate character study. Broad boxlike lower-face mass, black mouth, strong outer/fine inner lines and hatch gray recur with the mixed scene. The profile chin tapers somewhat, reflection face shape differs, and strong compacting of the internal features is not fully achieved. No detached heads or obvious extra limbs were observed.

summary.ja: 男女が登場する場面と、絵柄の魅力を見せる構図の実生成2枚。各画像の観察説明に、実際の表情・動作・描線と指定からの残差を記載しています。
summary.en: Two actual generated examples: a shared man-and-woman scene and a style showcase. Per-image observations describe actual acting, composition, drawing and prompt residuals.

limitations.ja: 原画2枚は別々の実生成です。同じ絵柄部分を使っていますが、顔・線・陰影や構図の指定への一致、他場面での再現性は保証していません。手指・道具や画外の部分の不確かさは各見本に記載。紙地風の色味も未加工で保持し、未指定seed/ネガティブは推測していません。点検は自己視覚レビューであり、人間の承認とは別です。
limitations.en: Two independently generated originals share the exact style recipe; adherence and cross-scene consistency are not guaranteed. Per-image notes retain uncertain fingers, props and cropped areas. Paper tints are unmodified; unspecified seed/negative are not inferred. Self-review is distinct from human approval.

title.ja: 白目と細かな線陰影のクラシック人物漫画風
title.en: Broad round white eyes and black-dot pupils in simplified character ink

prompt.en: Classic fine-line figurative manga ink. Eyes sit inside complete naturally proportioned human faces, with clear white fields, small round ink pupils and delicately curved brows. A lightly marked nose bridge and small mouth accompany restrained facial creases. Precise outside lines vary modestly in weight, while fine parallel and crossed strokes shade cheek, neck and fabric, leaving bright skin and small local black recesses.

references.title: ヒストリエ・正規無料本文6,7の可視顔断片

summary.ja: 男女を含む場面と、描法の雰囲気を見せる別構図の原画2枚。掲載した英語全文だけで実際に生成した見本です。
summary.en: Two original examples, including a man-and-woman scene and another composition showing the drawing mood, actually generated from the displayed full English text only.

limitations.ja: 参考の描法へ文章で近づけた実生成例です。顔・線・人数や構図には出力ごとの差があり、元絵や全指定との一致を保証するものではありません。
limitations.en: Actual text-only approximations of an observed drawing tendency. Faces, lines, cast and composition vary; exact source or prompt matching is not guaranteed.

prompt.en: A modest drawn working scene of a clothed adult woman and adult man arranging plain plants at one counter. The adult faces have clear white eye fields around small black pupils, spare facial marks and fine irregular hand-inked strokes. Their drawing remains a lightly hatched character comic, not a glossy polished anime portrait. Classic fine-line figurative manga ink. Eyes sit inside complete naturally proportioned human faces, with clear white fields, small round ink pupils and delicately curved brows. A lightly marked nose bridge and small mouth accompany restrained facial creases. Precise outside lines vary modestly in weight, while fine parallel and crossed strokes shade cheek, neck and fabric, leaving bright skin and small local black recesses. The woman has a simple wavy dark hair shape and wears a plain long-sleeved blouse and full trousers. The man has short dark hair, a small drawn moustache mark and wears a plain long-sleeved collared shirt and full trousers. Heads, connected shoulders, working arms, plant, counter and simple shelves occupy one continuous room.

observation.ja: 男女が同じ作業場に描かれた場面。白目と細い瞼線、黒髪と線陰影が参考の人物漫画調へ一部近づいています。顔は整い気味で、魅力画の眼は横長です。
observation.en: A man-and-woman working scene. Eye whites, fine lids, dark hair and line shading partly approach the character-comic reference. Faces remain regularized and showcase eyes are elongated.

prompt.en: A candid working moment in a small flower shop. A fully clothed adult woman stands at one workbench, holding a plain vase steady and arranging leafy stems. Classic fine-line figurative manga ink. Eyes sit inside complete naturally proportioned human faces, with clear white fields, small round ink pupils and delicately curved brows. A lightly marked nose bridge and small mouth accompany restrained facial creases. Precise outside lines vary modestly in weight, while fine parallel and crossed strokes shade cheek, neck and fabric, leaving bright skin and small local black recesses. She has a simple dark bob and wears a plain long-sleeved blouse and full trousers. Her face, connected shoulders and working arms, vase, workbench, shelves and window belong to one room.

observation.ja: 人物と植物を使う別構図の魅力見本。白目と細い瞼線、黒髪と線陰影が参考の人物漫画調へ一部近づいています。顔は整い気味で、魅力画の眼は横長です。
observation.en: A separate figure-and-plant showcase. Eye whites, fine lids, dark hair and line shading partly approach the character-comic reference. Faces remain regularized and showcase eyes are elongated.
